claims.text: On 24 March 2026, ACM reported tests of around 100 of the largest Dutch online stores, as well as large telecom and energy providers' websites. On 61% of checked websites, ordering with assistive technology was impossible; 33% had serious problems that made ordering harder.
claims.authority_or_court: Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM)
claims.legal_basis: EAA; ACM publication describes supervision of e-commerce and electronic communications services.
claims.stage_detail: Stage is limited to the dated source; no later outcome inferred.
